source.note: From a Telegram material group for B.Tech first year (batch 2024-25, all branches; sections A-C and D-F), exported with its chat. Folder names were written from the chat messages each file was posted with, so they carry the context (course, unit, experiment number, who wrote it). Applied Physics lab videos: Expt 1 and Expt 3 were recorded in the lab during Covid by students and shared as the lab's demonstrations. Files by 'S.M. Talha' are Syed Mohammad Talha's own notes and scans. Published textbooks and solution manuals in the chat were left out already; if a file is still a scanned book, reject it. Course numbers for 2024-25 first year: APS1112 Applied Physics, ACS1112 Applied Chemistry, AMS1112 Applied Maths-I, MEA1122 Engineering Mechanics, ELA1112 Principles of Electronics, EEA1112 Principles of Electrical, MEA1112 Thermal Sciences, EZH1112 English, CEU1112 EVS.
